title: High Society and his own variations
summary: Burbank says his High Society variation is his own idea.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Well, now, when you play High Society, I know you play that part that everybody plays, and then you go home and play another variation. Where did you get that second variation from? Well, it's just my own idea. I just make anything up to my mind. Mm-hmm. Well, that's a very nice solo. I've always liked that through the years.

I think that's a good one. There's another number. I know there's a special kind of featured Kranath part. That's St. Louis Blues. I know you and Piku, Rie Lee Barnes, George Lewis, all play that one special little part, you know, that chorus. That you mean that solo? Yeah.
